patthana5.2:150.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho abyākato ca anidassana sappaṭigho abyākato ca anidassana appaṭigho abyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. satta,
patthana5.2:151.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. satta,
patthana5.2:152.1: anidassana sappaṭighaṃ abyākatañca anidassana appaṭighaṃ abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā satta,
